IDEA: [kind: LNS / relaxation-guided neighbourhood selection (RINS)] Compute the root LP relaxation once in an isolated HiGHS instance and, on alternating LNS rounds, fix preferentially the integer variables where the incumbent agrees with the LP relaxation (RINS neighbourhood) instead of a purely random subset, alternating with the existing random fixing for diversification.

<<<<<<< SEARCH
Phase 2: fix a random subset of the integer variables at the incumbent, re-solve the sub-MIP with a short time
limit, keep improvements; the fixed fraction adapts (widen when a sub-MIP is solved to optimality, tighten when
it times out).
=======
Phase 2: fix a subset of the integer variables at the incumbent, re-solve the sub-MIP with a short time
limit, keep improvements; the fixed fraction adapts (widen when a sub-MIP is solved to optimality, tighten when
it times out). The subset alternates between a RINS neighbourhood (fix variables where the incumbent agrees
with the root LP relaxation, freeing the disagreeing ones) and a purely random subset for diversification.

    # root LP relaxation reference for RINS-style neighbourhood selection (best effort, isolated instance)
    lp_ref = None
    if deadline - time.time() > 8 and len(int_idx) <= 300000:
        try:
            g = highspy.Highs()
            g.silent()
            g.readModel(instance_path(a.target))
            g.setOptionValue("threads", 2)
            g.setOptionValue("random_seed", int(a.seed) % (2**31 - 1))
            g.setOptionValue("time_limit", float(max(1.0, min(0.15 * a.time, deadline - time.time() - 5))))
            for j in int_idx:
                g.changeColIntegrality(int(j), highspy.HighsVarType.kContinuous)
            g.run()
            if g.getInfo().primal_solution_status == highspy.SolutionStatus.kSolutionStatusFeasible:
                v = np.array(g.getSolution().col_value, float)
                if v.size == n and np.all(np.isfinite(v)):
                    lp_ref = v
            try:
                g.clear()
            except Exception:
                pass
        except Exception:
            lp_ref = None

    # phase 2: adaptive LNS around the incumbent
    fix = 0.8
    use_rins = lp_ref is not None
    while time.time() < deadline - 2:
        k = int(fix * len(int_idx))
        if use_rins and k > 0:
            agree = int_idx[np.abs(lp_ref[int_idx] - np.round(best["x"][int_idx])) <= 1e-6]
            if len(agree) >= k:
                chosen = rng.choice(agree, size=k, replace=False).astype(np.int32)
            else:
                rest = np.setdiff1d(int_idx, agree, assume_unique=True)
                extra = rng.choice(rest, size=int(k - len(agree)), replace=False)
                chosen = np.concatenate([agree, extra]).astype(np.int32)
        else:
            chosen = rng.choice(int_idx, size=k, replace=False).astype(np.int32)
        use_rins = (lp_ref is not None) and not use_rins  # alternate RINS / random neighbourhoods
        vals = np.round(best["x"][chosen])
